profile_validation.input_parallel_optional: requires thread budget>=4; N4 SimpleITK CPU, SynthSeg explicit cuda:N

worker_behavior.command: sys.executable FNIT modules, not original brain-imaging stage binaries
worker_behavior.device: Explicit kwargs/requests. Dedicated GCA/WM/N4 set_device; MNI and Triton launchers use cuda.device guards; hemisphere bootstrap/sync/properties explicit target.
worker_behavior.precision: Snapshot TF32 passed to hemisphere/MNI workers; no autocast enabled by FNIT. Dedicated GCA/WM use declared TF32 default.
worker_behavior.failure: phase-specific failed report and exception; no native algorithm fallback. Same callable pre-GO startup retry only for explicit CUDA OOM before operation entered.
worker_behavior.shared_outputs: Private hemisphere publication; parent defects writes LH then RH; MNI/mesh join before completeness.

precision.reported_forwards: static evidence of recording device/dtype/TF32/autocast, not new measurement
